defects.severity: low (defensive: unreachable with a representable in-memory SCT, but AGENTS.md section 3 requires local checked allocation arithmetic)
defects.class: three unchecked usize length sums used as allocation/encoding extents: 4 + sig_len in i2o_SCT_signature, 43 + ext_len + 4 + sig_len in i2o_SCT, and the running len2 + 2 + sct_len in i2o_SCT_LIST
defects.description: The authority computes each extent in size_t and lets it wrap; a wrapped extent would size a buffer below the bytes the encoder then writes. sig_len/ext_len are caller-settable through SCT_set1_signature/SCT_set1_extensions, so the crate must not reproduce the wrapping arithmetic.
defects.fix: signature_encoded_len, v1_encoded_len and list_encoded_len use checked_add; overflow answers -1 (the authority's own no-encoding outcome) instead of a wrapped extent. Control: ct::ct_oct::tests::encoded_length_sums_are_checked.
defects.divergence: For lengths that wrap size_t the authority's result is undefined/implementation-defined; this crate refuses. No representable SCT reaches the overflow.
